criteria.label: Factual accuracy
criteria.guidance: Flag claims unsupported by evidence; block clear, harmful misinformation.

criteria.label: Safety (harm, threats, self-harm)
criteria.guidance: Block direct threats, self-harm encouragement, or instructions for violence.

criteria.label: Bias and protected-group targeting
criteria.guidance: Flag targeting based on protected attributes; block slurs and dehumanizing language.

criteria.label: Personal information exposure
criteria.guidance: Flag emails/phones/addresses if non-public; block doxxing.

criteria.label: Adheres to platform policy
criteria.guidance: Flag minor policy drift; block clear violations of named policy sections.

criteria.label: Clarity / coherence
criteria.guidance: Flag incoherent or unreadable content. No BLOCK option.
